trace.command: cat /workspace/skills/noacg-graphic/references/setup.md; ls /workspace/skills/noacg-graphic/references/; export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; noacg --version || npm install -g /mnt/session/uploads/noacg-cli.tgz; noacg --version

mkdir -p ~/.pki/nssdb && (certutil -d sql:$HOME/.pki/nssdb -N --empty-password 2>/dev/null; for c in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/*.crt; do certutil -d sql:$HOME/.pki/nssdb -A -t C,, -n "$(basename "$c")" -i "$c"; done); echo rc=$?; export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; noacg doctor; noacg types

export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; cd /workspace && for d in ig02 ig11 ig12 ig13; do noacg scaffold --type poll --design $d --out /tmp/p-$d >/dev/null 2>&1; done; noacg scaffold --type poll --design ig02 --out /workspace/graphic; ls -R /workspace/graphic; for d in ig02 ig11 ig12 ig13; do noacg screenshot /tmp/p-$d --out /tmp/shot-$d.png 2>&1 | tail -2; done

cd /workspace/graphic && sed -i 's/font-size: calc(21px \* var(--scale) \* var(--type-scale));/font-size: calc(24px * var(--scale) * var(--type-scale));/' css/template.css && ls && export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio && noacg validate /workspace/graphic --screenshots /workspace/shots 2>&1 | head -3 && noacg record /workspace/graphic --out /mnt/session/outputs/record.json | tail -2
export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; noacg inspect /workspace/graphic 2>&1 | head -40; noacg coverage /workspace/graphic --out /mnt/session/outputs/coverage 2>&1 | tail -15

cd /workspace/graphic && sed -i 's/flex: 0 0 calc(330px \* var(--scale));/flex: 0 0 calc(420px * var(--scale));/' css/template.css && export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio && noacg validate /workspace/graphic --screenshots /workspace/shots 2>&1 | head -3 && noacg record /workspace/graphic --out /mnt/session/outputs/record.json | tail -2 && noacg coverage /workspace/graphic --out /mnt/session/outputs/coverage | tail -1
